Calculator Application Requirements

1. Functional Requirements:
   - The system shall provide basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division)
   - The system shall handle floating-point numbers with precision up to 2 decimal places
   - The system shall prevent division by zero and display appropriate error messages
   - The system shall maintain a running result that can be cleared
   - The system shall validate input parameters to ensure they are numeric

2. Performance Requirements:
   - Operations shall complete within 100ms
   - The system shall handle up to 1000 calculations per second
   - Memory usage shall not exceed 10MB during operation

3. Security Requirements:
   - Input validation must prevent buffer overflow attacks
   - The system shall sanitize all user inputs
   - Error messages shall not reveal internal system information

4. User Interface Requirements:
   - The system shall provide clear operation buttons (+, -, *, /)
   - Results shall be displayed immediately after each operation
   - Error messages shall be user-friendly and actionable

5. Data Requirements:
   - The system shall store the current result value
   - Historical calculations may be logged for audit purposes
   - All numeric values shall be validated before processing
